Name: Wildroot Chronicles
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[color=#d9ead3][b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790054084-1536745600.png[/img][/font][/size][/b][/color]
[center][b][size=4][color=#6d9eeb][font=Comic Sans MS]You've planted parsnips a thousand times.[/font][/color][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][color=#6d9eeb][font=Comic Sans MS]But this time is different — some grow faster, or draw a drift of butterflies...[/font][/color][/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#3c78d8]Wildroot Chronicles[/color][/b][color=#3c78d8] adds [/color][b][color=#6fa8dc]crop breeding[/color][/b][color=#3c78d8] to Stardew Valley, along with [/color][color=#6d9eeb][b]new characters, and new places[/b][/color][color=#3c78d8] to explore![/color][/font][/size][/center]

[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=5]At a glance[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[center][color=#9fc5e8][font=Comic Sans MS][b]112 traits & varieties · 14 rare species · 15 new crops ·8 characters · 80+ story events · 2 main new maps[/b][/font][/color][/center]

[center][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ea9999]Languages: English / 简体中文[/color][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#6d9eeb][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Version 1.4.0[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790070547-669905318.jpg[/img][/center]
[line]



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790064215-288017420.png[/img]
[center][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6][font=sans-serif][i]Meet characters[/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][b]
[color=#d9ead3][size=4]8 new characters across more than 80 story events[/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790062595-1520939924.png[/img]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790061349-1817393021.png[/img]
[center][i][b][color=#6aa84f][size=5][font=sans-serif]Grow something new[/font][/size][/color][/b][/i][/center]

[center][size=4]Some traits are [b]practical[/b]: [b]faster growth and regrowth, better quality[/b]. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Others are [b]just for looks[/b], like drifting [b]butterflies and fireflies, or falling petals[/b].[/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790252729-281854209.png[/img]
[center]
[size=4][b]1.Plant and [color=#6aa84f]discover mutated plants[/color][/b]
[b]2.Collect [color=#6aa84f]source samples from mutated plants[/color] and [color=#38761d]mother samples from normal plants[/color][/b]
[b]3.Combine the source and the mother(they should be same variety)[/b]
[b]4.[color=#b6d7a8]Name your seeds and products![/color][/b][/size]
[/center]


[i][size=4][color=#f4cccc][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790059979-1633023784.png[/img][/color][/size][/i]
[center][color=#b4a7d6][size=5][font=Georgia]🌸[/font][i] [b][font=sans-serif]Keep a record of every discovery[/font][/b][/i][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Your [/font][/size][/color][b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#93c47d]Breeding Almanac[/color][/font][/size][/b][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS] records every trait, variety and rare species you find.[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]Hunt down all [/font][/color][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#c27ba0]rare species[/color][/font][/b][color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS], display [/font][/color][color=#d5a6bd][font=Comic Sans MS][b]your best crops at the Exhibition Tent[/b][/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS], and keep an eye out for the butterfly migrations.
[i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787301655-1277526154.gif[/img][/i][/font][/color][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790415145-1924133339.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790065794-412330984.png[/img]
[center][size=5][i][b][color=#93c47d][font=sans-serif]Venture beyond the farm[/font][/color][/b][/i][/size][/center]
[center][size=5][i]
[color=#a2c4c9]Explore the Primal Grove and Night Watchers' Guild.[/color][/i][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790066241-1050008799.png[/img]
[line]

[i][b][size=5][font=Georgia]Want to know more? [/font][/size][/b][/i]
[i][b][size=5][font=Georgia]You can use the [color=#ff0000]offline wiki provided in the optional files[/color]![/font][/size][/b][/i]
[i][b][size=5][font=Georgia][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1787301656-2117264207.gif[/img][/font][/size][/b][/i]
[line]

[center][b][color=#ff7700][size=6][font=sans-serif]！Update Roadmap！[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Character & Romance Expansion ❤[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4] Continue [b]expanding and refining character events[/b], with [b]new dating events[/b], more [b]CG[/b], and [b]marriagable[/b] for more characters.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f][size=5]Forestry & Tree Breeding Update 🌳[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#93c47d][size=4] A themed content update [b]focused on forestry and tree breeding[/b].(Wait for the author of Woodlore to respond. Maybe can collaborate!) [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]Vanilla style portraits[/size][/color][color=#93c47d][size=4]  📷  [/size][/color]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=4]Due to the large workload, it will [b]take some time[/b]. Also welcome [b]any willing collaborators[/b].[/size][/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1790074546-117080096.jpg[/img]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#fce5cd][size=4]Other Plans[/size][/color][/i]
[i][b]Lite version[/b][/i]
[i]Once the main version reaches a sufficiently stable state, a separate Lite version is planned for release.[/i]
[i]The Lite version will focus primarily on the mod’s characters, maps, dialogue, and story content. Breeding and other major gameplay systems will not be included, making it more suitable for players who are mainly interested in exploring the new areas and meeting the characters.[/i][/font]
[line]

[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#e06666][size=6][i]🔧 INSTALLATION[/i][/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Requires [color=#9900ff][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/color].  [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install [color=#cc0000]SMAPI (4.0.0+)[/color] and [color=#cc0000]Spacecore.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unzip Cropgenics into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#f6b26b]Generic Mod Config Menu recommended[/color][/i][/b] [/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#d8d8d8][size=6]⚙️ COMPATIBILITY[/size][/color][/i][/font][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Most expansion mods — compatibility included[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Multiplayer — supported, with shared progress [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Works with most vanilla and mod-added crops that follow the game's standard crop data structure[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Install in an existing save[/font]

[line]
[center][size=6][font=Comic Sans MS][i][b]🐛 BUGS & SUGGESTIONS[/b][/i][/font][/size][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Cropgenics is still growing. If something breaks, include steps to reproduce and your SMAPI log (upload at smapi.io/log and paste the link in the Posts tab). [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e69138][size=4]Suggestions — new traits, rare flowers, balance feedback, event ideas — are just as welcome; I read every post.[/size][/color][/b][/font]
